02How it fits together

How information moves through your application

Every custom application we build follows the same clear structure, which keeps it secure, testable, and easy to extend.

  1. Users & roles

    Staff, managers, customers — each sees only what they need.

  2. Interface

    Forms, tables, and dashboards on web or mobile.

  3. API & business rules

    Validation, permissions, pricing, approvals.

  4. Database

    One source of truth with a history of changes.

  5. Reports & integrations

    Dashboards, exports, payments, messaging.

03Custom vs SaaS

Build custom, or configure an existing product?

Both are valid. Here’s how they differ in practice.

AspectExisting SaaS productCustom application
Getting startedSign up and configure in daysPlanned, designed, and built for you
Fit to your workflowYou adapt to the productThe product adapts to you
CostsPer-user monthly fees that grow with youUpfront build, then hosting and support
Data & ownershipStored in the vendor’s systemYour code, your database
Best whenA standard tool already does the jobYour process is your advantage

04Indicative workflow

From requirements to a working product

Timelines depend on scope and are agreed in writing after discovery.

  1. 01

    Discover

    We learn about your business, your users, and what the project needs to achieve.

  2. 02

    Plan

    We define the scope, features, platform, and technical approach in writing.

  3. 03

    Design

    We design the interface and user flows, and review them with you before building.

  4. 04

    Develop & Test

    We build, integrate, and test on real devices, sharing progress as we go.

  5. 05

    Launch & Support

    We deploy, hand over access, and provide the agreed support after launch.

FAQ

Common questions about this service.

All questions
Should I use a platform like Shopify or build something custom?

If a hosted platform already does what you need, it is usually faster and cheaper to start with. Custom development makes sense when your workflow, pricing, data, or integrations don’t fit the platform — or when monthly app fees start costing more than owning the software. We’ll recommend the option that fits your situation, even if it is the simpler one.

Who owns the project when it is finished?

You do. On delivery you receive access to your store or website, the source code for custom work, and the accounts used for hosting and services. Any third-party licenses (themes, apps, plugins) remain subject to their own terms.

How long does a project take, and how is it priced?

It depends on scope. After a short discovery conversation we send a written scope with the features, an estimated timeline, and a price for that scope. If requirements change during the project, we agree on the change before doing the work.
